reviews.validator_reason: The draft correctly acknowledges customer-reported facts (lamp buttons work, new batteries) sourced from the customer message. It asks a neutral yes/no question about prior pairing ('Haben Sie die Fernbedienung schon einmal mit der Lampe gekoppelt?') and follows up with a conditional observation question ('Falls ja: ...'). This structure does not assert that pairing was attempted, adhering to the rule for conditional questions. The troubleshooting context is supported by the retrieved knowledge document (citation_id 91583194-9711-5209-8cf0-323d722fb038), which discusses pairing issues and specific indicators (lamp flashing vs remote LED). No unsupported assertions, promises, or ledger facts are present.
